finding.finding: Verified current evidence reports grid power failure at Beruwala (S01) and Padukka (S09), and the HOM12-to-PAD85 backhaul link L09 is down. No equipment condition is stated.

The resolved faults are loss of grid power at S01 and S09 and a backhaul fault on L09. Matching repair and generator actions exist in the catalogue. No crews have the backhaul skill, so BH-L09 cannot be staffed with the listed crews. Crews C1 and C2 have equipment and generator skills; the listed roads are open. G1 is available, but its 120-minute runtime and 10-unit capacity may limit temporary-power use. No evidence says any action is unsafe or impossible, so no typed defer request is warranted.

questions.question: Can a backhaul-qualified crew be made available to repair L09? The listed crews have equipment and generator skills only.
What does G1's 10-unit capacity represent, and is it sufficient for the intended temporary-power deployment?

finding.finding: Apply the approved weights without changing them. S09 Padukka (V09) is the highest-priority affected service: it is critical (weight 5), has an authoritative report of mains loss with DC on batteries, and its upstream path from HOM12 is reported down. S01 Beruwala (V01) is also affected by an authoritative report of AC mains failure and is standard priority (weight 1). The reported HOM12-to-PAD85 transmission path failure may also affect S08 Homagama (V08), but the supplied evidence does not establish Homagama's equipment or power condition. findings: The cited authoritative snapshots support the recorded grid-power failures at Beruwala (S01) and Padukka (S09), and the down backhaul link L09 from Homagama to Padukka. The target mappings match the site directory.

The Veyangoda complaint, planned future Gampaha interruption, and unconfirmed Padukka repair rumour do not establish current asset conditions; treating them as non-operational claims is consistent with the rules.

The generator deployment route is DEPOT to S01, with 5 minutes of travel before work starts at minute 5. A 10-minute duration gives the recorded work end at minute 15. No cited evidence makes this action unsafe or impossible. Unmet needs are explicitly retained.
